etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English walnote, walnutte, walnotte, from Old English wealhhnutu (“walnut”, literally “foreign nut”), from Proto-Germanic *walhaz (“foreigner”) + *hnuts (“nut”). Cognate with Dutch walnoot, German Walnuss, Swedish valnöt, Icelandic valhneta. Compare more recent term Welsh onion, which also uses Welsh to mean “foreign”.

definitions.definition: A hardwood tree of the genus Juglans.
A nut of the walnut tree.
Dark brown colour, the colour of walnut wood.
Having a dark brown colour, the colour of walnut wood.
